text: The accepted CalDavSession constructor stores only username. The unit server still passes a second old argument, and a generic request assertion compares request.session.id with gServer.session.id. The base session inspected here has no id, so equality of two undefined values does not establish identity. The request constructor stores the session object directly. Replace this local assertion with object identity or an explicitly defined contract property when updating the test. This is a static test concern; no runtime failure was reproduced. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Test CalDAV session identity using a real object or defined property
